{{Quote|I must get my father to Mount Krisklar immediately, where skingles may eat out his heart, eyes, and liver in respectful fashion.|Kharys|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''Skingles''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of flying creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[S'kytri]] people [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] them for [[Diet/Legends|consumption]], which prompted the skingle to hide in the [[Entyrmion]], a network of underground caves, where the [[guanomonger]]s would [[Diet/Legends|feast]] on their feces. When a S'kytri [[Death/Legends|died]], his or her corpse was exposed on [[Mount Krisklar]], where the skingles would excarnate it.
